study type: Quality improvement study comparing two birth cohorts (ambidirectional)
outcome: obstetric indications for elective cesarean sections
non-obstetric indications for elective cesarean sections
cohort: The study included 7713 nullipara term singleton vertex (NTSV) births.
finding: The implementation of a composite quality improvement intervention significantly reduced the NTSV cesarean section rate from 30.89% to 13.31% without negative impact on core fetal outcomes.
mod_finding: The composite quality improvement intervention led to a substantial reduction in cesarean section rates for NTSV births, decreasing from 30.89% to 13.31%.
